canonical_404_route.finding: The BFF exposes the generic action route template `POST /bff/actions/{type}/{id}/{action}` (services/control-plane/bff/command_adapters/router.py, `_CANONICAL_ACTIONS_ROUTE`), but `action` must be a catalog action_id. The pantheon backend's own canonical contract (services/control-plane/bff/BFF_COMMAND_API_CONTRACT.md section 8.1 'Strategy Actions', and the strategy adapter's status_map in services/control-plane/bff/command_adapters/strategy_adapter.py) only recognizes `promote_paper` and `promote_live` for the strategy entity — there is no action_id literally named `promote`. Action-id validation happens before the auth check for this route, so an unrecognized action_id 404s instead of 401ing like every other protected route.
